result:
The area of a triangle is calculated using the formula: $\text{Area} = \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height}$.

Given:
*   Base = 10 meters
*   Height = 5 meters

$\text{Area} = \frac{1}{2} \times 10 \times 5 = 25$

The area of the triangle is **25 square meters**.
